password.title: Password
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency used to display amounts (budget, shopping, dashboard). Amounts already entered are not converted when you change it.

location.title: City
location.description: Used for tomorrow's weather and outfit suggestions on the dashboard. Enter a city name (e.g. Lyon, Montreal, Dakar) — the location is found automatically.
location.notFound: City not found — check the spelling or try a larger town.

email.title: Email notifications
email.description: Get reminders (appointments, tasks, contracts, warranties) in your inbox. Emails are sent to
email.testSent: Test email sent to {{email}}. Remember to check your spam folder.

export.title: Export data
export.description: Download all your data (budget, tasks, recipes, members, shopping, appointments, schedules, meals) as a JSON file.

import.title: Import data
import.description: Restore data from a KeurTonux export file. Existing data is not overwritten (duplicates are ignored).

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. The change is immediate and kept on this device.
